svg.aria-label: The function that checks, asks and posts, line by line. A limit allows three asks per order in half an hour. The checks run in plain Python with no AI. The review card asks the person while the AI is paused. A failed rule never reaches an Approve button. Any answer except a clean Approve counts as no. Only after an approval does doPost check the order again, ship and invoice, and read stock and balance back.
svg.text: The function that checks, asks and posts
From bc-posting/index.js, trimmed
